Sustainable Bitcoin Protocol (SBP)

Description: Institutional-grade energy verification and attestation infrastructure for Bitcoin mining. Provides compliance tooling, market infrastructure, partner onboarding, and related research for institutional participants.

Canonical: https://sustainablebtc.org
